reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. mandatory attendance quiz over the textbook pages every class day. his tests are way too hard and the material is not comprehensible. told us that he wants the class to have a C average and told us that was normal.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, the whole structure of the course changed. I would take this class with someone else. I'm honestly afriad I won't be able to get a B with how hard it is.

I'm currently in his class and he will find any reason to not give you an a, he also gives a quiz every morning before class, I will most likely drop his class soon. My piece of advice: Do anything you can to take it with another professor, save yourself while you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Such an awesome prof. Very kind and his lectures are super entertaining. 4 exams and a final. All online. Attendance not mandatory.

Professor Crick uses his own textbook for all the quizzes and tests, which is super short, so all you really have to do is read the chapters (maybe 15 minutes of reading) and show up to class. He is super disorganized and his grading is really subjective, but overall a good class.

Prof Crick is amazing!!! This class was so interesting, I genuinely looked forward to it. His lectures are engaging and he really cares about his students. Homework was very reasonable and he was always happy to talk through things if you were confused. If you have a chance to take any class with him, do it!

Dr. Crick is very kind and passionate about his class! There are 4 exams, the final, and a group project but he drops the lowest exam and you can also do the group project individually or with people outside of the class! He makes the class very interesting, reading and attending the lectures is important though!

He was a fantastic professor. His lectures were essential for understanding the material and tests. He makes you read his book, which goes hand in hand with understanding questions on tests, but it's an interesting read. Tests are primarily actual/false with matching and are your only grade. He is awesome and cares about his students.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Some of the best and most interesting lectures I have been to in college! He is so passionate about the subject. Take any of his courses if you get the opportunity. Beware, tests are a little tricky and you do need to go to lectures and read textbook to do well on them. But it's worth it! Honestly sad the course is over. Take his course!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor; lectures aren't required but are needed to do well on tests. The entire course is weighted off of tests, but he does drop the lowest one at the end of the semester. Tests are based on lecture and book content but are taken online from anywhere and are open notes.

Nathan Crick is a legend. I loved his class so much. genuinely interesting material that will change the way you communicate with people. I will say though, it's one of the more challenging Comm classes, but you can ace it if you are prepared to put in the work with reading and self-application.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are super confusing and difficult to follow. His entire class is on a Prezi and the definitions of the concepts he talks about are super difficult to understand, the examples he uses during class are dated and not explained well. Your entire grade is test grades and he asks very specific questions from the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Crick is very knowledgeable about what he teaches. He lectures very well and gives examples that help concepts to stick in students' minds. This was my most challenging comm class this semester, but I genuinely enjoyed it and think it expanded my critical thinking skills and study habits. Don't forget to take notes over his video examples!

One of the smartest and funniest professors I've ever had. This class is hard and it will challenge you, but getting a good grade is very rewarding and the lectures are so worth it. He uses examples for every concept and there wasn't a single class where I didn't laugh. Cannot recommend him enough!!

I love Dr. Crick. He is very passionate about what he is doing and the lectures are interesting and fun. You need to read the book. The tests are open book/open note, but you definitely need to read the book before the tests to be successful. He does curve.

I loved Dr. Crick! He is so intelligent and it's really interesting to hear him lecture. This class does have hard concepts, so definitely attend because it is solely graded on tests. They are online which helps, but can be tricky. Really fascinating class!

Dr. Crick is amazing, he is a great lecturer and his lectures are very engaging. He also gives great examples and makes concepts easy to understand. Attendance is not mandatory but definitely attend class. Lectures are very informative and examples from lectures are asked about on exams. The grade is based on exams but he is very fair.

I adored Dr. Crick! He is extremely intelligent and is obviously very passionate about the subject he teaches. The only thing that was difficult is his lectures can sometimes talk in circles and his definitions can be confusing. Pay attention in lectures and download his novel online and you will do fine. Exams are online as well. TAKE HIM!
It is just 4 exams and the final is a big portion of the final grade, but the exams are not hard. Would 100% take all his classes again

Taking a class with Crick is like watching your favorite anime dubbed in English. The content should be good, but the more you listen, the dumber you feel

Would not recommend

King!!!! I've had Crick for 2 classes and he is easily one of the best profs I've ever had. This course is fascinating and relevant with a pretty minimal workload. Grading and feedback is honest but forgiving. As long as you read (or at least skim) and show up to class, you will do well.

Everyone said the class is hard, but everyone that showed up for all lectures did great. Literally, just go to all his lectures and format your notes like "Term: Definition, Example" and you're set. He goes into immense detail but doesn't expect you to catch it all. You only need a basic definition. All exams are open note and he curves.

Great guy, even better instructor. Literally wrote his own textbook, so if you go to class you should be fine. If you're prone to skipping, don't take him. Concepts can get confusing so consistent attendance is necessary to get a good grade. Makes the course super interesting!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Crick is hands down the best teacher I've ever had in my life. He's wicked smart and can actually teach. Learned & retained so much. Tests T/F on book & matching for lecture examples, need to understand concepts. Lots of grade boost opportunities, easy A if you study (I ended with a 102). Cannot recommend Crick enough, he's my favorite person.
10/10 would take again. He is super engaging which was challenging with the class being taught specifically over Zoom. Honestly, could not find a better communication prof. 9/10 would ask to adopt me

Dr. Crick is a great professor, you can tell he really cares about the subject but also wants his students to succeed. I took his class as a mini-mester and it was a bit harder than expected but he was super nice and willing to work with me so I was able to get the grade I wanted. As long as you do the work you'll have no problems.

His lectures were very interesting and he does a really good job of explaining concepts in an engaging way. He explains how because his test arent proctored and theyre open note, he makes them more challenging and he means it. You wont pass without the book or watching lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love this man. I didn't read and I still made an A (command F comes in clutch). The reviews help prepare you for the test. All you need to remember is chapter summaries and examples he uses in class. Also, I anticipated how hard the final would be but it wasn't that bad at all.

Love this man. He uses examples to help you understand concepts which really help. I didn't read and I still made an A (command F comes in clutch). The reviews help prepare you for the test. All you need to remember is chapter summaries and examples he uses in class. Also, I anticipated how hard the final would be but it wasn't that bad at all.

Took Prof Cricks 438 blended class. I stayed strictly online and I will say the lectures were hard to piece together bc connection in the building was spotty. Other than that he was an awesome prof, gave great feedback on papers and allowed you to re-do until you got a 100. Kept lectures interesting & tests were very straight forward!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly if my whole college career was taught by Dr. Crick, I'd be on the dean's list. He is such a great professor and if you have the opportunity to take him I would take the chance.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Yall... prepare for a lot of studying. However, He is my favorite professor that I have had at A&M. He tells you exactly how to study for exams, hes very organized, and he curves if the class average if it isnt around a 75. This is one of those classes that sucks when youre in it, but then you feel so prepared for future classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Crick is a wonderful teacher. He is very funny to begin with and is entertaining to listen to. He knows what he is talking about. If you're someone who learns with examples, Dr. Crick always has a tangible example to point to that helps you learn. Tests are difficult I would say, but if you come to class and participate, it helps!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is the hardest class I have ever taken. He does a good job of recognizing when questions on the tests may be unfair and also adds a small curve. The tests are based on half lecture and half textbook and he does not discuss the textbook material in class. Questions are so specific that it is ridiculous. I studied weeks before tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing + caring prof w/ hilarious & engaging lectures. Learned SO much. Test #1 was hard, but review lectures/concepts well & an A is 100% doable. SUPER understanding. Gave points back on questions that class missed/were confused by. Easy extra credit to majorly boost grade. Great at explaining and dumbing down hard concepts. Rare gem- take him!!!

cares a lot about students. the material is difficult but he uses movie clips to help understand. dumb down the concepts in your notes and it's easier to understand. 4 tests and drops lowest grade and then a final. you have to read the textbook because he does test questions on it. group project at the end but offers extra credit on it if done well

Profesor Crick is a good lecturer, but a hard test maker! This is the hardest COMM class I have taken at TAMU, but I got a B, so passing is SO attainable. You just have to study a lot and learn how to study for this class. 4 exams (drops 1), a final and project. Project is easy, so is a grade booster. Overall, solid choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Crick is a great professor and teaches the course using Prezis. He makes the material easy to learn via references to pop culture and videos. you will not pass this class by memorizing quizlets, you need to go to the lectures, dumb down the concepts in your notes, and make your own examples.

Dr. Crick is a very interesting and kind professor. The course is fun, but the tests can be very difficult. You definitely have to study to do well on the tests, as the material can get confusing, and the only grades are tests and one group project. Overall, I would take this course again, but study more for the first couple of tests.

Crick is an awesome teacher. 4 tests and a final, as well as a group project that gives a possibility to add points to your final grade. He also drops your lowest test grade. Tough tests, but really comes down to just understanding and learning rather than memorizing. Tough class, but he is a great teacher of the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Crick has been my favorite professor of my college career thus far. His lectures are captivating and he's a goofy and laid back guy. Some concepts are difficult to grasp so going to class is definitely recommended. I would 100% take a class from him again.

Loved this class. Crick is one of the best profs I've ever had. The class is fairly difficult to get an A in because your grade is based solely on tests and one group project, but I still really enjoyed the course and would definitely take a class from him again.

Dr. Crick is by far one of the greatest profs at TAMU. He is very genuine and so intelligent. His class is not easy but he makes it worth going to. Attendance is not mandatory but his exams go off of his lectures so don't skip! He gives great examples in class and his lectures are not boring. Great prof, highly recommend!

Dr. Crick has been one of my favorite professors at TAMU thus far. His passion for the subject combined with his wit and compelling prezi presentations make for excellent lectures, and the content is interesting to boot.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Crick is a good teacher. His exams are tricky but they do get better with time. He grades you on 4 exams but drops the lowest grade. There is also a final and a group project. I enjoyed his class but you definitely have to study for his exams.

reviews.comment: He's funny and the lectures are engaging; however, the tests are extremely specific and difficult. The content is very philosophical and abstract, making it hard to comprehend. reviews.comment: Very witty. Tough but once you get through the first test you get a better idea of what to study. He's very accessible outside of class if you make an effort. He is worth taking because his teaching style is very active and creative. He uses Prezis and funny videos. Offers extra credit. Barely uses the textbook. Don't skip.
The tests are tough but he really wants students to succeed. He curves on the tests if he recognizes his questions are vague or confusing.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I was expecting COMM 301 to be very hard, I've heard horror stories, especially from Crick, but surprisingly it wasn't that bad. Crick has entertaining lectures, he uses funny videos to help you remember the material and his tests are fairly easy. Overall not a bad class, but you will have to work

reviews.comment: While this class is extremely difficult, I have really enjoyed it. Crick is such a funny guy, and you can tell he really cares about his students. His tests are extremely difficult, but I always ended up doing better than I thought. 10/10 would take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Crick is amazing! COMM301 is very philosophical and the exams go into great detail, so if you want an A you must go to class and study hard. It is critical that you know how to apply concepts in rhetoric to real world examples in order to do well on the exams. I really enjoyed this class and highly recommend taking it with Crick!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He tries to make lectures as interesting as possible and relates the material to popular culture a lot which makes class fun! he puts the prezi's online which is the main source of content for the test. but you need to know anything and everything for the test. we have a group project where you can earn extra credit at the end of the semester.

Dr. Crick's class was incredibly interesting but tricky. Go to class and listen to the lectures! He posts the Prezi's on eCampus but it's not enough to fully understand concepts. Tests are very hard, he usually asks in reference to an example in class or original texts. No textbook, he provides PDF's, read them!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Crick gets a lot of bad rep for his challenging class. But it's not because he's a terrible professor. He's actually an amazing teacher, but her really want to challenge you on the exams to really think about the material. What saved me in this class were study groups and going to class. Get yourself a GroupMe and go over everything before the exam

Crick is a really nice guy. He is a great lecturer and makes class interesting with different videos throughout his lectures. The only grades are one group project and 4 tests. THE TESTS ARE HARD. If you do not study, you will not pass. Lectures aren't mandatory, but GO IF YOU WANT A GOOD GRADE. But seriously study for the tests and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: GREAT prof, extremely passionate and very interesting to listen too. Lectures are not mandatory but you do not wan to miss them. Take good notes. Do every reading and do not wait until the last minute. Very helpful when you don't understand a concept. This was one of the hardest classes I've ever taken, but was also one of my favorites. 10/10

Took in Fall 2016. Great lectures, engaging course material. First three-fourths of the course were Prezis that he would make available on eCampus, last fourth was traditional, chalkboard, writing-intensive lectures. Tests were hard, STUDY!! Four tests (drops the lowest test grade), video project, & a cumulative final. Responsive with emails.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This guy rocks! He's passionate and knowledgeable about the subject matter, and it shows in his lectures.  He acts like he's having a conversation with the class as opposed to monologuing and that makes all the difference.  There's a ton of reading, but it's all online and he highlights the important stuff FOR you.  Study hard and you'll do great!
His lectures are very heavy in content and can be hard to understand, but he is ery entertaining and helpful outside of class.
